links.comparator_used: AI suggestion alone (same dose recommendation shown without feature-importance explanation)
links.outcome: Influence on ICU clinicians' continuous-valued drug prescriptions
links.effect: Simple feature-importance XAI did not have higher influence than AI alone. Additional information (peer, AI or XAI) strongly influenced prescriptions, significantly for AI. The abstract reports no numeric effect sizes. Marginal impact of simple XAI was described as low.
links.quote: We found that additional information (peer, AI or XAI) had a strong influence on prescriptions (significantly for AI, not so for peers) but simple XAI did not have higher influence than AI alone.

design_hint: AI explanations (feature importance) alongside AI recommendations
